claim_one_line: π₁(m004) reaches the geometric index 12 at level (2)³=(8), so the figure-eight knot group IS a congruence subgroup — three 2-adic levels deeper than its sister m003. [CORRECTED 2026-11-11 (the audit's finding E2; the error ledger's E23; B734's addenda of 2026-07-21 and 2026-09-16): the congruence level is (4). In SL(2, O₃/(4))/{±1}, the group that PSL(2, O₃) maps to, the image of the knot group already has the geometric index 12 (160 in 1920), and 6 at (2); 2 is inert, so no ideal lies between. "12 at (8)" is the reading in the quotient by every central unit of square one (order 960 at (4)), a filtration in which containment is sufficient for congruence and not necessary.] The knot group is congruence one 2-adic power deeper than its sister m003, not three.
